description: This file defines functions and types for converting Markdown to Telegram-compatible HTML, with special handling for file references and HTML tag management to prevent unwanted URL previews in Telegram messages.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes HTML special characters (&, <, >) in a string.

methods.name: escapeHtmlAttr
methods.description: Escapes HTML special characters in attribute context, including quotes.

methods.name: buildTelegramLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor tag for a Markdown link if it is not auto-linked file reference.

methods.name: renderTelegramHtml
methods.description: Converts Markdown IR to HTML with Telegram-specific styling and link handling.

methods.name: markdownToTelegramHtml
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to Telegram-compatible HTML, optionally wrapping file references.

methods.name: escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: getFileReferencePattern
methods.description: Generates regex to match file references with TLD extensions.

methods.name: getOrphanedTldPattern
methods.description: Generates regex to match orphaned TLD file references.

methods.name: wrapStandaloneFileRef
methods.description: Wraps standalone file references in <code> tags unless they start with // or follow a URL.

methods.name: wrapSegmentFileRefs
methods.description: Wraps file references within a text segment, considering nesting depth.

methods.name: wrapFileReferencesInHtml
methods.description: Wraps file references in HTML to prevent Telegram URL previews, handling auto-linked anchors and HTML tags.

methods.name: renderTelegramHtmlText
methods.description: Renders text as Telegram HTML, trusting HTML mode or converting Markdown.

methods.name: buildTelegramHtmlOpenPrefix
methods.description: Builds opening tags for a list of HTML tags.

methods.name: buildTelegramHtmlCloseSuffix
methods.description: Builds closing tags for a list of HTML tags.

methods.name: buildTelegramHtmlCloseSuffixLength
methods.description: Calculates total length of closing tags.

methods.name: findTelegramHtmlEntityEnd
methods.description: Finds the end index of an HTML entity in a string.

methods.name: findTelegramHtmlSafeSplitIndex
methods.description: Finds a safe index to split HTML without breaking entities.

methods.name: popTelegramHtmlTag
methods.description: Removes a specific HTML tag from a list of open tags.

methods.name: splitTelegramHtmlChunks
methods.description: Splits large HTML into chunks within a size limit, maintaining tag integrity.

methods.name: renderTelegramChunkHtml
methods.description: Renders a Markdown IR to HTML and wraps file references.

methods.name: renderTelegramChunksWithinHtmlLimit
methods.description: Converts Markdown IR to multiple HTML chunks within size limit.

methods.name: markdownToTelegramChunks
methods.description: Converts Markdown to multiple Telegram HTML chunks within size limit.

methods.name: markdownToTelegramHtmlChunks
methods.description: Converts Markdown to an array of HTML chunks within size limit.
